def read_and_transform():
    s = input()
    length = len(s)
    print(s[0], end='')
    visited = [False] * (length + 1)
    visited[0] = True
    i = 1
    while i <= length - 3:
        visited[i] = True
        if s[i] == 'a' and s[i + 1] == 't':
            print('@', end='')
            visited[i + 1] = True
            i += 2
        elif s[i] == 'd' and s[i + 1] == 'o' and s[i + 2] == 't' and i != length - 3:
            print('.', end='')
            visited[i + 1] = True
            visited[i + 2] = True
            i += 3
        else:
            print(s[i], end='')
            i += 1
    for j in range(length):
        if not visited[j]:
            print(s[j], end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    read_and_transform()
